dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular, interconnected light-grey 'O' and 'C' shaped loops are clustered along the dorsal ridge, exhibiting sharp outer perimeters against the dark fur with a high-contrast gradient transition to slightly darker interior centers.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of localized white-to-light-grey pixel clusters concentrated in a large, elongated patch on the mid-lateral section, with smaller, solid-intensity speckles scattered sparsely across the anterior dark region.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most prominent dorsal annuli form an obtuse scalene triangle, which maintains a near-vertical spatial relationship with the centroid of the primary lateral high-intensity blob cluster.

other_distinctive_markers: A sharp, high-contrast horizontal boundary line separates the dense dark dorsal pigmentation from the heavily mottled and lighter lateral region.
